dataset_story: A comprehensive survey of account takeover incidents across African social media platforms, documenting attack vectors, platform responses, and user impacts.
aura_purpose: Used to model multi-stage account takeover (ATO) risk and identify regional attack patterns.

overview.name: Africa Social Media ATO
overview.title: Africa Social Media Account Takeover Survey Dataset

citation.text: Udodi (2025). Africa Social Media Account Takeover Survey Dataset. NeurIPS.

attack_type.description: Specific method used for account takeover (e.g., Phishing, SIM Swap, Session Hijack)

platform.description: Social media platform where the incident occurred

monetisation_method.description: How the attacker intended to profit (e.g., Crypto, Mobile Money, Ransom)

compromise_score.description: Calculated score indicating the depth of account compromise

label.description: Binary indicator of successful account takeover
